description: See the chart you are building: returns a PNG of it -- candles, volume, every indicator and drawing -- rendered the way Basis draws it, plus the exact figures it shows. Use it to check structure, levels and what you drew before you describe them. Build first with the chart tools, or pass symbol, timeframe, indicators and levels to build and look in one call. Pixels are for shape; quote numbers from the figures or the data tools.

bars.description: Bars to show, 20-500. Default 150, widened to include every drawing.

indicators.description: Ids or common names ("ema50", "rsi", "bollinger"), or {studyId, params}.

levels.description: Prices to mark as horizontal lines, or {price, label, color}.

symbol.description: Optional: set the instrument in this call.

name: chart_image
